name: Imp

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical Darkness doesn't impede the imp's Darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The imp casts Invisibility on itself, no components.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.desc: The imp turns into a rat, raven or spider, or back into its true form.

desc: A tiny devil that bargains, flatters and lies — and reports everything to its master.
